lines.en: Can you help me turn on the computer?
Sure, Grandma. Push this button here.
lines.ko: 네, 할머니. 여기 이 버튼을 누르세요.

lines.en: The screen is on. Now what do I click?
Click the yellow folder. Your file is in there.
lines.ko: 노란 폴더를 클릭하세요. 파일이 그 안에 있어요.

lines.en: I saved a document there last night.
I see it. Even the name is correct.
Great. Can I open it with the keyboard?
Yes. But please don't delete the file.
I will be careful. Thank you so much.
Tomorrow I will show you how to print it.
Hello. Can you print this document for me?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 이 문서를 인쇄해 줄 수 있어요?

lines.en: Of course, Ma'am. Is the file on your phone?
Yes. My grandson sent it this morning.
Good. How many copies do you need?
Two copies, please. It's for my English class.
lines.ko: 두 부 부탁해요. 영어 수업에 쓸 거예요.

lines.en: Okay. I will click here and print it now.
Wow, it's fast. Even the picture looks good.
Do you want me to delete the file now?
Yes, please delete it. Thank you very much.
Done. Have a nice day!
